# N30: Small workspaces: a tab or a module’s row waits until it has something in it, and every address still opens

A check of the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/30-small-menu.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured.

## What it checks

small workspaces, rows and tabs that wait (SM1, rule 1). [SMALL-MENU] In the demo the menu is unchanged (it has a metric, so Metrics is a row). On Goals no tab but All is the same list as All, a tab is drawn only with goals in it, and every hidden scope's address still opens: ?scope=team (to All when My team waits) and ?scope=watching. In a workspace with no metric the Metrics row waits, also when you switch to it from one that has a metric without the page reloading (build review of #461: the row once followed you there).

## What it reports as wrong

- no metrics: crashed ({String(e.message || e).split('\n')[0]})
